caption: The drawing depicts a wooden rocking horse set against a plain, light background. The horse is oriented in profile, facing left. The body, legs, and base are made from what appears to be wood, illustrated in various shades of brown. The wood is depicted with visible grain and texture and shows some darker areas, suggesting wear or aging. The horse has a detailed head with a red-painted open mouth and visible eyes, and there is a small protrusion above the head resembling an ear. The horse's tail is short and curved upward. The seating area is situated on the horse's back, where a child would be seated. The rockers at the bottom are long and curved, supporting the horse and designed for rocking motion. There are no additional objects or background elements present, except for a rectangular strip of light brown color near the top edge of the image, above the horse, possibly part of the paper or a remnant from previous handling. The composition is centered, with the rocking horse as the main and only subject of the drawing.
title: Rocking Horse
